title: Pure C Series
summary: The "C" Series is a family of EARTH Insect handtraps and field-swarming disruption monsters that punish the opponent for Special Summoning. Using Shiny Black "C" Squadder and Giant Ballpark to flood the board with Level 4 Insects, the deck searches out Contact "C", Retaliating "C", and Sneaky "C" while linking into Beetrooper and Insect Extra Deck bosses.

allow.Resonance Insect: Searches high-level Insects when sent to GY and dumps Gokipole when banished via Retaliating "C".
allow.Gokipole: Searches Shiny Black "C" Squadder or Retaliating "C" when sent to the GY, and destroys an opponent's monster if it searches a Normal Monster.
allow.Giant Ballpark: Field Spell that negates battle damage to send and summon up to 3 copies of Shiny Black "C" Squadder from Deck/GY.
allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Giant Ballpark Field Spell.
allow.Inzektor Picofalena: Link-2 Insect that equips Gokipole or Retaliating "C" from the Deck to trigger their GY search effects.
allow.Seraphim Papillion: Link-3 Insect boss that revives Level 4 or lower "C" Insects as a Quick Effect.
allow.Number 3: Cicada King: Rank 3 Insect Xyz accessible via Level 3 "C" monsters that negates monster effects and revives Insects.

main: Retaliating "C"
Special Summons itself when the opponent activates a Spell that Special Summons, applies a Macro Cosmos floodgate, and searches any EARTH Insect with 1500 or less ATK when sent to the GY.
Contact "C"
Special Summons itself to the opponent's field when they Normal or Special Summon, locking them into using it as Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link material.
Flying "C"
Special Summons itself to the opponent's field in Defense Position when they Special Summon, completely locking them out of Xyz Summoning.
Sneaky "C"
Special Summons itself face-down when the opponent Special Summons and wipes all Special Summoned monsters during the End Phase.
Confronting the "C"
Special Summons itself when the opponent Special Summons from the Extra Deck and is completely unaffected by Monster effects that target it.
Super Armored Robot Armed Black Iron "C"
Special Summons itself by banishing 3 same-name Insects from GY and destroys all opponent's monsters with equal or higher ATK to an equipped Insect.
Shiny Black "C" Squadder
Level 4 2000 ATK EARTH Insect Normal Monster that triggers Gokipole's pop effect and swarms via Giant Ballpark.
Shiny Black "C"
Banishes itself from the GY to destroy 1 face-up Synchro Monster the opponent controls.
Gokipole
Searches Shiny Black "C" Squadder to pop a monster, or searches Retaliating "C" and Contact "C" when sent to the GY.
Resonance Insect
Searches Super Armored Robot Armed Black Iron "C" and sends Gokipole to the GY when banished.
Giant Ballpark
Summons 3 Shiny Black "C" Squadder from Deck/GY to overwhelm the board and fuel Link/Xyz summons.
Terraforming
Searches Giant Ballpark.
extra: Equips Gokipole or Retaliating "C" from the Deck and recycles 3 GY Insects to draw 1 card.
Link-3 Insect boss that gains counters and revives "C" monsters during the opponent's turn.
Rank 3 Xyz made with Level 3 "C" monsters for monster effect negation.
